We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. title: Back End Engineer
description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Senior FullStack Engineer

WPP Open

- Engineering
- Gurugram

About the job:

WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Senior Engineer you own a component or service, from its design and API to its tests and production health, and you mentor other engineers. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

Responsibilities:

- Design, build, test and ship production code every sprint, test-first.
- Own a component or service end to end: its design, OpenAPI contract, data model, Playwright test suite, monitoring and runbook.
- Write design documents and architecture decision records for your component, and review other engineers' code with rigour and care.
- Choose between AWS Lambda and Kubernetes for your workloads, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline that ships them.
- Lead triage when your component fails, write post-incident reviews and fix the underlying causes.
- Build production AI features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, and maintain your component's Claude Code configuration and MCP server.
- Explain technical trade-offs to product and delivery colleagues, including colleagues in other regions.
- Mentor less experienced engineers and help new joiners become productive quickly.

Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 5 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python.
- 3 years of experience testing, maintaining or launching production software, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
- Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with stakeholders in other regions.
- Backend language and craft. You write idiomatic, strictly typed backend code in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, with runtime validation at service boundaries using Zod or Pydantic. You understand concurrency in your language well enough to recognise blocking work and profile a misbehaving service, and you know NestJS, Fastify or FastAPI in depth.
- React and frontend. You choose and justify state-management approaches in React, keep rendering fast through memoisation, lazy loading and code splitting, and meet WCAG AA accessibility on the

features you build. You contribute components to the design system and can build interfaces that stream responses from AI services.

- APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI and own the contract for your service, including versioning, backwards compatibility, idempotency keys, rate limiting and webhooks. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and you check schema compatibility automatically in your pipeline.
- Data. You design PostgreSQL schemas and change them without downtime, tune slow queries and understand transaction isolation. You model data well in both DynamoDB and MongoDB, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload with clear reasons.
- Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design producers and consumers on queues such as SQS and BullMQ or Celery, with retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent handlers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You recognise when these safeguards are needed before anyone asks.
- Cloud and platform. You design services on AWS Lambda, with sensible function boundaries, concurrency settings, dead-letter queues and Step Functions or EventBridge where needed, all defined

as code with AWS CDK or SAM. You operate workloads on Kubernetes, including Helm, autoscaling, rollouts and rollbacks, and you choose between serverless and containers for each workload.

- Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and apply it to the design of whole components, not just individual functions. You write integration and contract tests with Testcontainers and

own your component's Playwright test suite, including test data, parallel runs and removing flaky tests.

- Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry, own the Datadog monitors, alerts and CloudWatch alarms for your component, and lead triage and post-incident reviews

when it fails. You set performance budgets, profile under realistic load, and find memory leaks and blocking work in production.

- Security and identity. You implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect end to end, including the authorisation-code flow with PKCE and client credentials for service-to-service calls. You design role based access control, rotate secrets and keys, and secure your supply chain with dependency scanning and static analysis in the pipeline.
- Architecture and design. You design a service from a short brief, write design documents and architecture decision records that name the trade-offs, and design for backwards compatibility so that

changes do not break the people who depend on your service.

- Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow and hold others to it in code review. You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, treat every dependency as something to pin and upgrade on a regular cadence, and write documentation for the people who will read it. AI-first engineering and LLMs. You build production features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, using tool calling, structured output and evaluations, and you track token usage and cost. You maintain the Claude Code configuration for your component, including CLAUDE.md, skills and subagents, and have built an MCP server that exposes your service to AI agents.
- Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely, and you explain technical trade-offs to product, design and delivery colleagues in terms they can act on. You understand problems quickly and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and time zones, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly. You are proactive: you spot problems before you are asked, propose solutions and improvements of your own, and see them through without waiting for instructions.
- Leadership and behaviours. You review others' code with rigour and care, mentor less experienced engineers, and disagree openly when you need to and then commit fully to the decision. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

Preferred qualifications:

- B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
- Experience with monorepo tooling such as Nx or Turborepo at scale.
- Experience with Kafka and change data capture.
- Experience with behaviour-driven development using Cucumber.
- Experience with Bigtable.
- Experience shipping an AI agent with LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
- Experience configuring an identity provider such as Okta, Keycloak or Cognito.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to redefine management education for the digital and AI-first world. We are building technology that powers transformative learning experiences for thousands of learners across India. From learner journeys and assessments to AI-enabled learning experiences and internal platforms, our engineering team plays a critical role in shaping the future of education.

As a Senior Software Engineer II (SDE II), you will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling high-performance web applications that deliver exceptional user experiences. You will work across the full technology stack, collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Business teams, and take ownership of key product initiatives from ideation to deployment.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, writing clean and scalable code, and building products that create meaningful impact.

Key Responsibilities

- Build reusable, modular, and high-quality components that enhance application performance and maintainability.
- Translate business requirements and product specifications into elegant technical solutions.
- Own features end-to-end—from technical design and development to deployment and post-release monitoring.
Engineering Excellence & Architecture
- Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to engineering best practices and coding standards.
- Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions that improve scalability and reliability.
- Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and help maintain a high engineering quality bar across the team.
- Continuously improve application performance, security, and overall system reliability.
Collaboration & Cross-Functional Execution

- Collaborate with QA teams to ensure high-quality releases through effective testing and validation.
- Support technical discussions, sprint planning, and estimation activities within the engineering team.
- Mentor junior developers and contribute to fostering a collaborative engineering culture.
Performance Optimization & Problem Solving
- Identify bottlenecks and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and responsiveness.
- Troubleshoot production issues, debug complex technical problems, and implement sustainable solutions.
- Monitor application health and proactively improve system stability and user experience.
Quality, Testing & Continuous Improvement
- Develop and maintain unit, integration, and functional tests to ensure application reliability.
- Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for applications, APIs, and engineering processes.
- Stay updated with emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices, driving continuous improvements within the engineering team.

What We're Looking For
- 3-5 years of experience in full-stack software development using the MERN stack.
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Strong proficiency in MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, NestJS and Node.js.
- Experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web development
- Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
- Exposure to Docker, cloud platforms (AWS preferred), CI/CD pipelines, or containerized deployments is desirable.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering scalable solutions.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
- High ownership mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Why Join Us?
- Build Products That Matter - Create technology that impacts the learning journeys and careers of thousands of professionals.
- Engineering with Ownership - Work on challenging product problems where your ideas and technical decisions have meaningful influence.
- High-Growth Environment - Be part of a fast-scaling organization that values innovation, speed, and engineering excellence.
- Continuous Learning - Work alongside experienced product and engineering leaders while continuously expanding your technical expertise.
- Collaborative Culture - Join a team that believes in transparency, ownership, intellectual honesty, and continuous improvement.

About the Company

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift inthe skills ecosystemat the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA studentsfrom legacy institutes who are unplacedand professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception.

Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India’s top digital commerce companies as it’s investors.

As a hands-on technical leader, you will help define the architecture and technical direction for Member Records while continuing to build production software. The screens you build are not cosmetic — they are where human reviewers approve payments, resolve invoice exceptions, configure ERP connectors, and track STP performance across clients. You will work in React or Angular on the frontend, Node.js or Python for backend APIs, and DynamoDB for data storage — all hosted on AWS. You will collaborate closely with AI engineers, backend platform engineers, and finance domain SMEs to deliver a product that is both technically solid and genuinely usable by finance operations teams.

Key Responsibilities- Build and maintain the Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) worklist UI — enabling finance reviewers to view queued tasks, inspect AI recommendations with supporting context, take approval or rejection decisions, add notes, and trigger escalations.

- Develop the exception management dashboard — displaying real-time exception queues by type, aging bucket, and priority, with drill-down into individual exception detail, resolution history, and lifecycle status.
- Design and implement RESTful APIs in Node.js or Python that serve the frontend, connecting UI interactions to the underlying platform services — orchestration, exception routing, approval workflows, audit trail, and notifications.
- Design DynamoDB table schemas and access patterns for workflow state, tenant configuration, exception lifecycle records, and audit events — applying single-table design and GSI strategies for efficient querying.
- Implement real-time UI updates using WebSockets or Server-Sent Events (SSE) to keep worklists, exception queues, and workflow status indicators live without full-page refreshes.
- Integrate with AWS Cognito or equivalent for authentication and role-based access control — ensuring that tenant isolation, approver role restrictions, and audit trail requirements are enforced at the API layer.
- Collaborate with AI and backend engineers to surface LLM-generated recommendations, confidence scores, and agent reasoning in the UI in a way that helps human reviewers make faster, better-informed decisions.
- Ensure frontend observability — client-side error tracking, performance monitoring, and usage analytics — to support continuous improvement of the user experience across clients.

Required Skills- 5+ years of fullstack engineering experience with strong proficiency in React or Angular and Node.js or Python.

- Strong TypeScript skills across both frontend and backend.
- Hands-on experience with AWS services — Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, Cognito, SQS, and SNS.
- Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs — including API design, versioning, error handling, and pagination.

title: Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Remote, full-time role for a Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer based in India. You will own the core platform of an AI-enabled drug-development product, working directly with the founder and a US-based Forward Deployed Engineer. A daily 3-hour overlap with US Pacific Time (typically Indian evenings) is required.

Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer
Engagement Model: Full-Time / Employer of Record (EOR)
Compensation: Competitive Market Rate (Commensurate with Full-Stack & Multi-Agent AI Depth)
Location: India (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, or NCR preferred)
Target Experience: 5+ years of full-stack software engineering with demonstrable AI/Multi-Agent system depth, including 2+ years building and deploying production LLM / Multi-Agent AI systems.

About INCEVO LLC
INCEVO LLC is a biopharmaceutical consulting firm delivering end-to-end program leadership, functional expertise, and BD due diligence to help life sciences companies advance therapies from discovery through regulatory approval. INCEVO is pioneering a proprietary AI-enabled drug-development platform— integrating real-time intelligence, regulatory insight, and predictive analytics to accelerate decision-making and de-risk portfolio investments — positioning the firm at the forefront of next-generation biopharma strategy.

About the Role
We are seeking a Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer to take complete operational ownership of our core platform codebase—from database schemas and asynchronous backend microservices to responsive, highly polished user interfaces. In this high-velocity, high-agency role, you don't just write basic API wrappers; you build resilient, high-throughput systems that turn complex AI capabilities into fast, reliable enterprise product. You will work directly with the founder and our Forward Deployed Engineer to iterate product features, optimize LLM inference speeds, and enforce rigorous engineering standards across our stack.

Why This Role Matters: As our Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will own the technical engine powering our platform and drive it across the finish line into a polished, hardened, enterprise-ready product that performs flawlessly in live client programs. The domain problem is genuinely novel: orchestrating drug development with AI agents is an unsolved enterprise challenge, and you will build the UI components, backend microservices, and system reliability required to make it seamless for global pharma clients. If you want to architect production-grade agentic AI in one of the most important industries in the world, this is that role.

What You’ll Do
· Drive Enterprise Production Polish & New Feature Surfaces: Refine, refactor, and expand our core web application (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind) to elevate it from a functional platform into a high-performance, enterprise-grade product. Own the addition of new UI components, micro-interactions, and backend workflows while maintaining clean, scalable frontend architecture. Translate client program needs into intuitive UI components with minimal friction. Incorporate architectural insights surfaced by our Forward Deployed Engineer from live client deployments to ensure new product surfaces reflect real enterprise client workflow needs.
· Architect Low-Latency Agentic Backends: Build and maintain asynchronous REST and WebSocket microservices (FastAPI / Node.js) handling multi-agent state persistence, tool calling, inter-agent orchestration (LangGraph), streaming tokens responses, and parallel data/document ingestion pipelines. Ensure every API endpoint is fast, reliable, and self-documenting. Performance and reliability under concurrent client load are non-negotiable.
· Optimize AI & RAG Pipelines: Implement, benchmark, and maintain production vector retrieval pipelines, hybrid search (BM25 + dense vector), evaluation harnesses (Ragas, TruLens), and multi-tier caching structures (Redis / semantic caching). Own execution repeatability and token efficiency across all LLM workflows.
· Ensure System Reliability & Observability: Write robust test suites (PyTest, Playwright), implement structured data validation (Pydantic), and build fallbacks and circuit-breakers for when downstream LLM APIs experience latency or outages. Proactively surface system bottlenecks before users encounter them — and translate reliability findings into concrete architectural improvements that make the platform progressively more resilient across every client deployment cycle.
· Maintain Engineering Hygiene: Strong Git discipline (atomic commits, clean rebase/PR workflows), structured pull requests, self-documenting code, and end-to-end CI/CD ownership (GitHub Actions). Every commit carries clear context and intentional changes.
· Collaborate Asynchronously: Operate autonomously with clear written documentation and maintain a mandatory 3-hour daily overlap with US Pacific Time for daily standup, sprint planning, and real-time collaboration. Work in close partnership with our US-based Forward Deployed Engineer — translating field-validated architectural requirements from live client deployments into platform improvements rapidly and precisely. Own the full handoff from architectural specification to live production code.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have:
· Startup Velocity & High Agency: You care deeply about shipping clean, self-documenting code fast and iterating rapidly based on real user feedback. You flag blockers early and propose architectural solutions, not just problems.
· 5+ Years of Full-Stack Engineering Depth: 5+ years of full-stack software engineering with demonstrable AI/Multi-Agent system depth, including 2+ years specifically spent building, deploying, and architecturally evolving production-grade LLM or Multi-Agent AI systems at enterprise scale. Strong proficiency across TypeScript, React/Next.js, Python (FastAPI/Pydantic), PostgreSQL, and Redis.
· Multi-Agent Systems & AI Expertise: Hands-on production experience with modern agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, LlamaIndex workflows), structured JSON outputs, vector databases (Qdrant, Azure AI Search, pgvector), and API integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, NVIDIA NIM). You understand how LLM-based systems fail in production differently from traditional CRUD apps — and you make deliberate architectural decisions that prevent, detect, and recover from those failure modes at scale.
· Async & Performance Optimization Mastery: Deep working knowledge of Python asyncio, streaming token consumption, memory management, time-to-first-token (TTFT) reduction, and API rate-limit/retry handling. You know when to reach for a WebSocket versus a polling endpoint and why it matters for perceived performance.
· Azure Stack Familiarity: Practical experience with Azure Container Apps, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Blob Storage, and Azure AI Search. Familiarity with Azure AD SSO and Key Vault is a strong advantage. You treat client program data with the same care a regulated pharmaceutical company would.
· Engineering Hygiene & IP Security: Strong Git workflow discipline (atomic commits, clean PR reviews, rebase hygiene), full CI/CD ownership via GitHub Actions, and clear written technical communication in English that non-technical stakeholders can act on. You treat INCEVO's codebase, agent architecture, and client program data as proprietary assets — maintaining strict IP security standards at every stage of development, deployment, and offboarding.
· Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration: You work effectively with a US-based Forward Deployed Engineer who owns client-facing deployments and brings real-world architectural requirements from the field. You translate those requirements into platform improvements rapidly and precisely — closing the loop between client reality and core engineering execution.
· Biopharma or Life Sciences Context (Significant Advantage): Prior experience building software for pharmaceutical, clinical research, or regulated healthcare environments — including familiarity with clinical data schemas (ClinicalTrials.gov, CDISC), regulatory submission workflows, or GxP system validation concepts — is a meaningful differentiator. The founding team provides full domain context; what we need from you is the technical stack mastery and execution speed.

Equal Opportunity & Confidentiality
· Equal Opportunity Employer: INCEVO LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We believe that building AI systems for high-stakes, complex domains requires diverse perspectives, deep intellectual curiosity, and rigorous engineering standards.
· Work Authorization & Intellectual Property: All offers and engagements are contingent upon the successful execution of INCEVO LLC’s standard Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and Intellectual Property (IP) Assignment Agreement prior to commencement. For international engagements, employment is administered in full compliance with local labor laws via our authorized Employer of Record (EOR) platform.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Dapr OSS) – India Lead
description:
Who We Are

We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era.

Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects.

Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr and KEDA open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio.

We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt).

About Dapr

Dapr (Distributed Application Runtime) is a graduated CNCF project that helps developers build distributed, cloud-native applications. It gives them APIs for the hard parts: durable workflows, actors, service invocation, state, pub/sub, scheduled jobs and secure service-to-service communication. Dapr runs in production at companies such as Zeiss, IBM, NASA, Bosch and Lufthansa.

About The Role

You join Diagrid's Runtime team, the engineers who build Dapr and run it inside Diagrid Catalyst. Your work lands in public, in the Dapr open source project, and in the product our customers run in production.

You will design and ship features in the Dapr runtime, review code from the community and from your team, and help keep releases stable. Much of the current work is in durable execution (Dapr Workflows, actors and the scheduler), where correctness under failure matters more than speed.

We build with AI every day. We look for engineers who use AI to go further and who check what it produces: you read the diff, you test the failure path, and you own the result, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft. In an open source project, reviewing and verifying code matters as much as writing it.

You are a full member of the team: the same ownership, the same voice in design, and the same chance to grow into a Dapr maintainer as everyone else.

Working hours

Diagrid's team works across Europe and North America.

Our India team’s day typically starts around 12:00 PM IST, with afternoons overlapping Europe and evenings overlapping the US. You’ll need to be available for a core US overlap window of 8:30 PM to 12:00 AM IST; outside that, you can structure your day flexibly.

What You Will Do

- Design and build features in the Dapr runtime, from proposal to release.
- Review pull requests from the community and from your team. Hold the bar on correctness, tests and API design.
- Find and fix bugs in distributed code: race conditions, retries, partial failures, and state that must survive a crash.
- Write proposals and design docs in public, and respond to review on them.
- Take part in Dapr releases: release candidates, patch releases and security fixes.
- Help users and contributors on GitHub and Discord, and mentor new contributors.

What We Look For

- 5+ years of professional Go, with production code you can explain line by line.
- Experience designing and running distributed systems. You know how they fail, and you design for it.
- 2+ years with Kubernetes and containers.
- A strong computer science base: concurrency, networking and data consistency.
- Daily, practical use of AI coding tools, and the judgment to check their output before you ship it.
- Clear written English. Most of our work happens in GitHub issues, pull requests and design docs, read by people across many companies and time zones.

Leading in India

You’ll be our first engineer in India, and you’ll help build the team that follows. Engineers who join in India will report to technical managers on their own teams, with a dotted line to you. Their managers own their day-to-day work and performance; you’re their local lead and point of contact.

- Help hire the India team: shape the hiring process, interview candidates and help us find the right people.
- Onboard new engineers and help them become productive in Dapr, our codebase and how we work.
- Be the go-to person in India for questions, feedback and support, and raise issues to their managers when needed.
- Build a strong engineering culture in India that matches how we work across Diagrid: ownership, quality and working in the open.
- Work with leadership on India-specific topics such as hiring plans, working hours and team setup.
- Represent Diagrid in the local engineering and open source community, through meetups, conferences and contributor outreach.

This role stays hands-on. Most of your time goes to engineering work on the runtime, and the leadership side grows as the team does.

Bonus

- Merged contributions to open source Go projects, especially CNCF projects.
- Experience as a maintainer of an open source project.
- Experience with Dapr, or with workflow and durable execution engines (Temporal, Azure Durable Functions, AWS Step Functions).
- gRPC and Protocol Buffers.
- One of the other languages Dapr has SDKs for: Java, Python, JavaScript, .NET or Rust.

- Flexible paid time off

title: Senior  or Staff Software Engineer, Inference / Compute Infrastructure Engineering
description:
About The Role

REMOTE IN INDIA

We're looking for a software engineer to build the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. You'll design a manifest-driven API where the inference team declares what they need, whether that's a cluster, a model deployment, or a capacity change, and our controllers handle the reconciliation, provider/runtime selection, and lifecycle management underneath, so the inference team never has to know or care which specific serving stack, scheduler, or hardware pool is doing the work. You'll also build the systems that keep the fleet efficient, not just running, including defragmentation and rebalancing logic that consolidates scattered workloads back into contiguous capacity, and scheduling/bin-packing improvements that push GPU utilization up without hurting latency. The core value we're after is decoupling the people building on top of the platform from the operational and runtime complexity underneath, while squeezing more usable capacity out of the same hardware. You'll build the controllers, reconciliation loops, and self-service surface (API/CLI, not tickets) that make that decoupling real, plus the event-driven health, remediation, and utilization systems that keep it running and efficient without a human in the loop. Strong candidates have hands-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, have built or operated a platform API that abstracts multiple backends behind one interface, understand GPU scheduling and capacity efficiency (fragmentation, bin-packing, right-sizing), and think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered.

A product mindset - you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.You build it, you own it. You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

Responsibilities

- Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
- Build the self-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
- Automate self-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
- Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.
- Partner with the inference/ML platform team: understand the cluster shapes they need — topology, interconnect, scheduling constraints — and encode them as first-class abstractions in the platform.
- Engineer it like software: strong typing, automated tests, code review, versioning, and CI/CD for infrastructure code — this is a product, not a collection of Ansible playbooks.

Requirements

Core requirements (all levels):

- Strong software engineering background in Go, Python, Rust, or similar — you write and test real software for a living.
- Experience with durable workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal, Cadence, or equivalent to run long-lived, manifest-driven workflows that survive failures and resume mid-execution.
- Experience building software control planes or orchestration systems that model state and reconcile it over time (e.g., Kubernetes controllers/operators, custom reconciliation loops, workflow engines).
- Experience with event-driven systems — designing and building software around message queues, event streams, or pub/sub (e.g., Kafka, NATS, SQS) rather than polling or cron-driven scripts.
- A product mindset. You’ve built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.

Nice To Have

- Exposure to bare-metal provisioning (PXE/iPXE, Redfish/IPMI, BMC) and/or networking fundamentals (VLANs, BGP, fabric design), or GPU/accelerator infrastructure.
- Experience with GPU cluster software stacks (NCCL, CUDA, InfiniBand/RoCE).
- Prior work at a hyperscaler, GPU cloud, or datacenter-scale infrastructure organization.
- Systems programming in Rust or Go.

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

title: Backend Software Development Engineer – Expert
description:
Location: Bengaluru, India

Function: (DEAI HV) Engineering

Requisition ID: R0132295

Our Company

We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.

About The Team

We build the object storage that AI-era workloads need. Our products help customers in regulated industries like finance, healthcare and legal store, protect and access huge amounts of data. The Object backend team owns the core of the platform: the S3 data path, metadata and database services, replication, data protection, and the distributed services that run large clusters.

Role Overview

We're looking for a senior backend engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of our core storage services. You'll design and build high-throughput, fault-tolerant server-side systems that work at multi-petabyte and billion-object scale. You'll own complex subsystems from start to finish, set backend engineering standards, mentor senior engineers, and be a go-to technical expert for Product Management, QE, Support and Services.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture, design and implementation of core backend services: the S3 request and data path, metadata management, indexing, garbage collection and background services.
- Design distributed, highly available systems with clear consistency, durability and failure-handling guarantees.
- Own the scalability and performance of the data and metadata layers. Profile, tune and remove bottlenecks in throughput, latency and IOPS-heavy workloads.
- Drive the evolution of database and messaging layers, such as PostgreSQL upgrades and tuning, distributed SQL (YugabyteDB), and RabbitMQ-based async processing.
- Design and improve replication, disaster recovery and data integrity features (multi-site replication, failover/recovery, checksum verification).
- Implement S3 API features and compliance, including versioning, Object Lock/WORM, lifecycle policies and multipart upload.
- Lead backend modernization work: runtime and language migrations (for example Python 3), containerization and Kubernetes-based services, and observability with Prometheus and Grafana.
- Act as the final escalation point for critical production issues. Lead root cause analysis for problems like JVM heap exhaustion, session or resource leaks, deadlocks and data availability issues, and deliver lasting fixes.
- Work with security teams to fix CVEs and harden backend services (encryption at rest and in transit, key management and rekeying, authentication and authorization).
- Set backend standards for API design, code quality, design reviews, testing and CI/CD, and mentor Senior and Specialist engineers across locations.

Required Qualifications

- BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
- 12+ years of backend or systems software development, with a strong record of architecting and shipping enterprise-grade distributed systems. 
- Expert-level Java skills, including JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and heap and thread dump analysis. Strong skills in Go and/or Python.
- Deep knowledge of concurrency, multithreading, networking, data structures and algorithms on Linux.
- Proven experience designing distributed systems: consensus/replication, partitioning, consistency models and fault tolerance.
- Strong hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), including schema design, query optimization and upgrades.
- Experience building and scaling RESTful/HTTP services and asynchronous, message-driven architectures.
- Excellent communication skills, and experience leading technical work across globally distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep storage domain experience: object storage internals, the S3 API, file or block storage, SAN.
- Experience with erasure coding or RAID, data deduplication or compression, and data integrity (MD5/SHA256).
- Experience with Yuga byte DB or other distributed SQL/NoSQL databases, and RabbitMQ or Kafka.
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, and with moving monolithic services to cloud-native microservices.
- Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, and with designing operational metrics and telemetry.
- Knowledge of security practices: encryption, KMIP key management, identity and access management, and secure SDLC.
- Experience with GitLab CI/CD and automated testing at the unit, integration and system levels.
- Patents, publications or open-source contributions in storage or distributed systems.

What Success Looks Like

- Core services meet scale, performance and reliability targets on large production clusters.
- Critical escalations and backend defect backlog go down measurably, and root cause analyses lead to fixes that stop the issue from coming back.
- Modernization milestones (database, runtime, telemetry upgrades) ship on plan without hurting stability.
- Your designs become standards other teams adopt, and the engineers you mentor grow into technical leaders.

Why join us

You'll build the core of mission-critical storage trusted by many of the world's largest enterprises. You'll have real influence on architecture and product direction, in a collaborative and inclusive culture that values innovation and respect.

About Us

We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.

Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives

Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.

How We Look After You

We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.

Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: Agentic Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Agentic Full-Stack Engineer

About Securin
Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Preemptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions — giving organizations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do.

Our Engineering Values
We build with agents and verify with humans — treating AI as a genuine collaborator, holding agent-generated code to the same review standard as human-authored code, and shipping features only when test coverage and security checks are in place. We take end-to-end ownership, write maintainable code, and bring security awareness into every decision — not as a checkbox, but as a core discipline.

The Role
A high-agency software engineer who uses coding agents as a force multiplier: generating design specs with AI, curating those outputs with engineering judgment, and shipping high-quality features at pace on the Securin cybersecurity platform.

Responsibilities
● Feature Development
Design and ship full-stack features for the Securin platform end-to-end — using AI coding agents (Claude) to generate specs and boilerplate, then curating those outputs with engineering rigor, security context, and architectural judgment before finalizing. Work with teams in the US and India to facilitate communication, operations, and design. Required to attend 1-2 US evening meetings a week to sync with India based teams.

● Agent & Automation Engineering
Build agentic workflows and automation pipelines that streamline engineering — and enforce a human-in-the-loop review process ensuring every AI-produced change is critically evaluated for correctness, security, and fit before it reaches production.

● Platform & Infrastructure
Architect and maintain cloud-native SaaS services on AWS, contributing to API design, data modeling, and microservices architecture that power real-time threat intelligence ingestion and delivery.

● Security Mindset
Apply secure-by-design principles throughout development and work alongside Securin's security researchers to translate vulnerability intelligence domain knowledge into robust platform capabilities.

Requirements
● 3+ years building production SaaS
● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
● Public cloud experience required (AWS preferred, GCP or Azure acceptable)
● Deep familiarity with:
○ Containerization
○ Serverless architecture
○ Event-driven architecture
○ RESTful API design

Culture-Forward Building with AI: What We Expect - Role-Specific
○ Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents is a prerequisite.
○ Must be able to critically review agent-generated code and specs for:
● Hallucinations
● Security flaws
● Architectural drift before merging.

General
Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate

GenAI tools into daily workflows - Automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it - designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate.

● Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work - drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the role.
● Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI-generated output before acting on it.
● Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques - structuring multi-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production-grade results.
● Comfort with agentic AI workflows - using, designing, or building multi-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human-in-the-loop validation.
● Awareness of AI security fundamentals - prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows.
● Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems.
● Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team-wide use.
● Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing within the team.

description:

At Anyscale, we're on a mission to democratize distributed computing and make it accessible to software developers of all skill levels. We’re commercializing Ray, a popular open-source project that's creating an ecosystem of libraries for scalable machine learning. Companies like OpenAI, Uber, Spotify, Instacart, Cruise, and many more, have Ray in their tech stacks to accelerate the progress of AI applications out into the real world.

With Anyscale, we’re building the best place to run Ray, so that any developer or data scientist can scale an ML application from their laptop to the cluster without needing to be a distributed systems expert.

About The Role

Anyscale is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Infrastructure team. Anyscale aims to provide the next generation of tools and infrastructure to make developing and running distributed AI applications in the cloud as easy as on your laptop. As part of the Infra team, we build the scalable, secure, and robust backbone that enables this vision.

Our team is responsible for both the control plane, which orchestrates cluster management, scheduling, and user access, and the data plane, which ensures high-performance execution of distributed workloads.

- Ability to design systems with a forward-looking perspective — thinking about how your architecture handles 10x growth, multi-region deployment, and evolving requirements
- Ability to contribute to and influence cross-team technical direction — you're not just implementing specs, you're shaping the solution

Programming & Framework

Few roles let you work at this many levels simultaneously. Day to day, you will partner directly with engineering and product leaders across the R&D organisation — shaping the roadmap, making the hard architectural calls, and being the person the team looks to when the path forward isn't obvious. What you build won't live in the background: it will be the foundation that tens of thousands of users interact with, the infrastructure that powers Abnormal's growing App Store, and the self-serve experience that makes onboarding and offboarding seamless for our customers.

Beyond the technical depth, you'll operate at the intersection of product strategy, distributed systems, and international expansion — shaping how Abnormal enters new markets, serves the public sector, and reaches customers across segments. The problems are genuinely hard, the stakes are real, and the team around you is strong. If you've been looking for the role where you finally get to build at full scale — with the autonomy to architect boldly and the context to make decisions that stick — this is it.

Nylun Global Private Limited is building **GST Software**, a GST compliance and business software for businesses and Chartered Accountant firms across India.

**Where we are today:** the core modules are built as an advanced working prototype. We are now building the **cloud SaaS platform**:

* a modern **React** web app
* a **FastAPI** backend
* a **PostgreSQL** database
* a small, secure **Windows agent** that connects to the cloud and runs automated tasks on the customer’s own computer

More products will follow, including audit and accounting software.

This is the best stage to join: you will help build a SaaS product from the ground up and see it go live.

**Who we are looking for**

We want a young, energetic, hands-on developer who is:

* **hungry for an opportunity** to prove themselves on a real product, not just maintain old code
* **ambitious to grow** with a fast-growing company and take on bigger responsibility
* **passionate about technology, automation and AI**, always learning new tools and better ways of working
* **an owner**, who takes responsibility for results, not only tasks
* **a team player**, happy to help and guide interns and freshers

If you have the skills and the fire to grow, and you want a place where your work is seen, valued and rewarded, this role is for you.

**What you will do**

* **Build the SaaS backend in FastAPI:** a modular monolith with clean REST APIs and OpenAPI documentation.
* **Build the React frontend** (Vite): fast, clean and easy-to-use screens, reports and dashboards.
* **Design PostgreSQL databases:** good data models, efficient queries and indexing for large data.
* **Build a multi-tenant system:** each customer’s data kept separate, with user roles and permissions, secure login and sessions.
* **Background jobs with Redis:** queues for long-running tasks such as imports, processing and report generation.
* **File storage:** store and serve documents and data files using S3-compatible object storage.
* **Build the Windows agent:** a Python tray application that connects securely to the cloud over WebSockets, receives jobs and sends back results.
* **Browser automation** with Selenium or Playwright:
* reliable automation of multi-step web workflows, with proper handling of sessions, timeouts, errors and retries
* always secure, and respecting each website’s rules
* **Packaging and updates:** build Windows installers for the agent and support automatic updates.
* **Admin and internal tools:** an operations admin panel for support, subscriptions and monitoring.
* **Quality:** automated tests (pytest), proper error handling, logging, code reviews, clean Git practice.
* **Use AI every day:** AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, to build faster, with the judgement to check and correct AI-generated code.
* **Work with our Chartered Accountants** to turn business requirements into accurate, working features.
* **Help guide interns and freshers** on daily tasks and code.

**Must-have skills**

* 2–3 years of hands-on software development experience.
* **Strong Python with FastAPI.** Experience with Flask or Django also counts.
* **React** (with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS).
* **PostgreSQL:** good SQL, table design, joins, indexes.
* **REST API design:** authentication (JWT/sessions), validation, error handling.
* **Browser automation:** hands-on experience with Selenium or Playwright.
* **Git**, and writing clean, readable code.
* **AI-first working:** daily use of AI coding tools, with real examples of how it helped you deliver faster.
* Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus.

**Strong plus**

* Redis, and background job queues (Celery, RQ, ARQ, RabbitMQ or similar).
* WebSockets and async Python (asyncio).
* Multi-tenant SaaS: customer-level data separation, roles and permissions.
* Windows desktop or tray apps, and packaging Python apps (PyInstaller, Nuitka, Inno Setup, MSI).
* Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), deployment to Linux, AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Automated testing with pytest.
* S3 or other object storage.

**Good to have**

* GST, accounting, tax or fintech software experience.
* Payment gateway integration (Razorpay), email and SMS services, Google sign-in (OAuth).
* Vite, React Query, Tailwind CSS or similar modern frontend tools.
* Node.js or another backend language.

**No GST knowledge? No problem.** Our Chartered Accountants will train you. We value strong engineering skills, attitude and willingness to learn.

**What we are NOT looking for**

* Someone looking only for a comfortable, routine job.
* Someone who copies AI-generated code without understanding or checking it.
* Someone who builds automation that works once and breaks often.
* Someone who wants to restart everything from scratch. We build carefully on the work already done.

**Why join Nylun Global Private Limited**

* **Build a SaaS product from the ground up** and see your work go live with businesses and CA firms across India.
* **A real opportunity to prove yourself:** your work directly shapes the product.

title: Software Engineer, Fullstack, Spend Controls
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Great spend controls help businesses move quickly without losing control of their money. Ramp’s Spend Controls team builds the core capabilities behind Ramp’s most critical primitives, like budgets and cards,helping customers put spending policies into practice and understand how their money is being deployed.



We’re looking for a fullstack engineer to build and improve these experiences, from the interfaces admins use to configure controls to the backend logic that makes them work reliably. You’ll build and own new features end to end, simplify complex spending workflows, and improve the quality of products customers depend on every day.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build fullstack features to improve how customers manage the lifecycle of issued money, with clearer behavior and sensible defaults

 - Work with product, design, and engineering partners to turn customer needs into well-scoped features and deliver them from technical design through launch and iteration

 - Build better visibility into spend and utilization, including configurable restrictions and sensible buffers, so that users can spend money easily, while transactions that shouldn’t happen are declined properly

 - Contribute to on-call support, investigate production issues, and address recurring problems through testing and targeted quality improvements




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Experience building and shipping production features across frontend interfaces and backend services

 - The ability to own a feature end to end, break down the work, design key components, and follow through on delivery

 - Sound judgment about data correctness, reliability, and keeping complex product behavior understandable

 - A customer-focused approach to building software, with attention to usability and practical tradeoffs

 - Experience testing and debugging software, including investigating issues in production

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working with product, design, and engineering teammates
